text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Yonge Street, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is recommending that the existing commercial loading zone in effect at all times on the east side of Yonge Street, between a point 30 metres south of Golfdale Road and a point 13 metres further south, be rescinded as it is no longer necessary. This will result in pay and display parking being in effect in this area.

City Council on July 19, 20, 21 and 22, 2022, adopted the following: 1. City Council rescind the existing commercial loading zone in effect at all times on the east side of Yonge Street, between a point 30 metres south of Golfdale Road and a point 13 metres further south.
